title: Door opens the wrong way
situation: A confident push on a door that pulls. The body bumps, she reads the sign, steps back, pulls it towards her while backing off, and walks round the swinging edge. The door panel is solid, so the body must clear it at every angle.
success_observation: Cardboard cut-out skin applied to 3D Bolas motion bank joints.
ledger: hartswf0/bolas T109 (Door opens the wrong way)
cardboard cut-out pieces (cast/dummy/ bola, shim, dot)
